title: Render a final recap block in the session summary
description: Add a final recap section to the session summary renderer so completed sessions surface a concise recap of fields while preserving the legacy summary payload.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: The renderer emits the final recap fields when a final recap is present.
AC2: Verbose and sensitive content is omitted once a final recap exists.
AC3: Empty final-recap lists render a clear 'none' placeholder.
AC4: The legacy session summary decisions and issues are preserved unchanged.
